permissions.manage_label: Create and download backups (full database copies)

panel.actions_help: Create a portable archive of your forum, restore from one, or transfer between Flarum installs.

list.empty: No backups yet. Click 'Create backup' to make one.
list.target_tooltip: This backup's SQL was generated for {engine}. Restore it onto a {engine} install.
list.confirm_delete: Delete this backup permanently? The .flarum file will be removed from the server.
list.load_failed: Could not load the backup list.

encryption.section_help: Encrypt new backups with an asymmetric keypair. The public key lives in the database, the private key MUST be pasted into config.php — the web process never holds a key it has not been told.
encryption.clipboard_unavailable: Your browser does not allow copying to the clipboard. Select the value manually.
encryption.clipboard_failed: Copy failed — your browser blocked clipboard access. Select the value manually.

status.load_failed: Could not load encryption status from the server.
status.libsodium_missing: libsodium is not available on this server. Encryption cannot be enabled.
status.healthy: Encryption is configured. New backups will be encrypted automatically when you tick 'encrypt' in the export modal.
status.not_setup: No encryption keypair has been generated yet. Backups will be saved in plain form unless you opt in per-export.
status.mismatch_body: The private key in config.php does not match the public key stored in the database. Existing encrypted backups cannot be decrypted on this server. Either restore the original private key, or rotate to a fresh keypair (which leaves the existing encrypted files unchanged but unreadable here).
status.private_missing_body: A public key was generated but the matching private key is not in your config.php. Existing encrypted backups will not decrypt here until the private key is restored.

public_key.label: Current public key
public_key.help_healthy: New encrypted backups will be sealed to this key. Anyone with the matching private key can decrypt them.
public_key.help_broken: Encryption is configured but cannot decrypt — see the alert above.

reveal_modal.title: Save your private key
reveal_modal.intro: We just generated a fresh keypair. The private half is shown ONCE below. Paste it into your config.php — we will not be able to show it to you again.
reveal_modal.warning_body: If you lose the private key, every backup encrypted with the matching public key becomes permanently unreadable.
reveal_modal.close: I have saved my private key

regenerate_modal.title: Rotate encryption keypair
regenerate_modal.warning: Generating a new keypair leaves any backups already encrypted with the OLD public key unreadable on this server (you can still decrypt them externally if you saved the old private key). New backups will be encrypted to the new key.
regenerate_modal.acknowledge: I understand and want to rotate.

export_modal.title: Create backup
export_modal.intro: Pick what to bundle. The result is a single .flarum file you can download, transfer, or store off-site.
export_modal.content_db_help: Every table — users, posts, settings, etc. The dump includes DROP/CREATE statements so it can be restored cleanly.
export_modal.content_assets_help: public/assets/ — avatars, attachments, anything users have uploaded.
export_modal.content_storage_help: Usually skipped: contains runtime files that can be regenerated and is rarely portable across installs.
export_modal.content_extensions_help: Bundle the source files of one or more installed extensions (from workbench/ or vendor/). Tick the box and pick which ones below.
export_modal.extensions_none: No extensions are installed on this Flarum.
export_modal.extensions_load_failed: Could not load the extension list.
export_modal.target_help: Where will this backup be restored? Pick the engine of the destination if it's different from this one — the SQL is generated for that engine, so you can migrate from MySQL to PostgreSQL (or any combination) without manual conversion.
export_modal.encryption_help: Uses libsodium hybrid encryption. The body is encrypted with a per-archive symmetric key, which is then sealed with a public key.
export_modal.encryption_external: Encrypt to a different public key (for transfer)
export_modal.encryption_external_help: Paste the destination server's public key. Useful when preparing a backup to restore somewhere else without sharing private keys.
export_modal.cancel_failed_warn: Modal closed, but the server may still be holding the export job lock. Check the backup list shortly — if a stale job persists, retry or contact support.
export_modal.phase_error_network: Lost connection to the server during the backup. The job may still be running on the server — check the backup list shortly.
export_modal.warnings_title: {count, plural, one {# translation warning} other {# translation warnings}}
export_modal.warnings_help: Some columns use types that don't have a direct equivalent on the chosen target engine. The backup itself completes — but the destination column may not validate or behave identically. Review each note below before relying on this backup for migration.

import_modal.title: Import a backup
import_modal.warning_body: Importing a backup overwrites the database and replaces files. Make sure you have a recent backup of THIS install first.
import_modal.upload_idle_timeout: The upload stalled (no data sent for over a minute). Check your network and try again.
import_modal.extensions_composer_note: composer.json is merged into this server's, never overwritten — nothing installed here is removed. composer.lock is NOT applied, because a lock from another server prunes packages that only exist here. Run `composer install` after restoring to materialise vendor extensions.
import_modal.selection_help: Pick which sections of this backup to apply. Anything you uncheck will be skipped at restore time — the corresponding files / database changes are simply not applied.
import_modal.server_state_help: Some state describes THIS server rather than the forum in the backup — SMTP credentials, queue driver, integration tokens, and the root extend.php. These options decide what survives the restore.
import_modal.section_preserve_settings: Keep this server's mail, queue and integration settings
import_modal.section_root_extend: Replace the root extend.php with the backup's
import_modal.root_extend_warning: The root extend.php is loaded before Flarum's error handler exists — a class it references that isn't installed here takes the forum down with a blank HTTP 500. The current file is copied to a .bak-* first, and the restore checks for unresolvable classes when it finishes.
import_modal.key_help: This archive is encrypted. Paste the matching base64 private key — it stays in this browser session and goes to the server with each step of the restore; it is never written to disk.
import_modal.key_hint_local: Leave blank to use the private key configured in this server's config.php.
import_modal.confirm_body: Tables in the archive replace tables here. Files are written to their original paths.
import_modal.confirm_check: I understand. Replace my current data with this backup.
import_modal.cancel_failed_warn: Modal closed, but the server may still be applying changes. Verify the server state before retrying.
import_modal.done_body: All selected files have been restored. The database was not modified, so your current session is unchanged.
import_modal.notes_title: Review before treating this migration as done
import_modal.incomplete_body: The restore ran to the end, but not everything selected was written. Review the details below before treating this migration as done.
import_modal.logout_body: Restoring the database replaced this server's `users` and `sessions` tables, so the account you were signed in with no longer exists here. Sign in again with the credentials of the imported forum to continue.
import_modal.logout_step_reload: Reload the page below to clear the stale session cookie
import_modal.logout_step_login: Log in with the admin credentials of the source forum
import_modal.phase_error_network: Lost connection to the server during restore. The server may still be writing — wait a moment and check the database state before retrying.
import_modal.url_rewrite_note: URLs in the database referencing the source server will be rewritten to this server's URL automatically.

export.file_changed: {file} changed while the backup was running; the missing bytes were filled with zeros.

import.extracting_entries: Extracting… {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}}
import.skipping_rewrite: Skipping URL rewrite (URLs match or unknown).
import.finished_dangling: Restore finished — the root extend.php references classes that are not installed.
import.finished_unwritable: Restore finished — {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} could not be written to disk.
import.finished_unresolved: Restore finished with {count, plural, one {# unrestored entry} other {# unrestored entries}}.
import.reconcile_failed: Could not reconcile the project root files: {error}. This server's composer.json and extend.php were left as they were.
import.preserved_reapply_failed: Could not write this server's settings back after the restore: {error}. Review mail, queue and integrations in the admin panel.
import.preserved_restored: {count, plural, one {# setting} other {# settings}} of this server were kept instead of the backup's (mail, queue, integrations). Adjust the list in `{key}` if something specific to your environment is still being overwritten.
import.boot_at_risk: BOOT AT RISK: the root extend.php references {count, plural, one {the class {classes}} other {the classes {classes}}}, which the autoloader cannot resolve. Flarum loads that file before its error handler, so this takes the forum down with an HTTP 500 and no message. Reinstall the package that provides the class or comment out the extender before reloading.
import.unwritable_destination: No write permission on {paths} (PHP runs as `{user}`). Entries meant for those paths will NOT be written — the database, assets and storage still go ahead. Fix the owner/permissions of those directories and restore again, or untick Extensions and install the packages with composer.
import.incomplete_unresolved: INCOMPLETE restore: {count, plural, one {# selected entry} other {# selected entries}} could not be written because the destination did not resolve{sample}. Check the archive integrity and the extension manifest before treating this migration as done.
import.incomplete_unwritable: INCOMPLETE restore: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} could not be written by the PHP user `{user}`{sample}. Fix the owner/permissions (or disk space) of those paths and restore again — the database was already applied, so repeating the restore with only Extensions ticked is enough.

project.incoming_invalid_json: The archive's composer.json is not valid JSON — this server's manifest was left untouched.
project.local_invalid_json: This server's composer.json is not valid JSON — merge aborted so the state does not get worse.
project.encode_failed: Could not serialise the merged composer.json — this server's manifest was left untouched.
project.write_failed: Could not write the merged composer.json (permissions?).
project.merged: composer.json merged into this server's (nothing was removed). The archive's composer.lock was NOT applied: a lock from another server prunes packages that only exist here. Run `composer update --lock` to rewrite the local lock.
project.fresh_manifest: This server has no composer.json — the archive's manifest and lock were applied verbatim. Run `composer install`.
project.only_here: Packages that exist only on this server and were NOT in the backup (kept by the merge): {packages}. Make sure the root extend.php and the restored extensions are still compatible with them.
project.only_there: Packages required by the backup and missing from this server: {packages}. Run `composer install` to install them before treating the migration as done.
project.extend_write_failed: Could not write the root extend.php (permissions?).
project.extend_replaced: Root extend.php replaced by the backup's (the previous one was saved as .bak-*).

stack.php_too_old: This backup was made on PHP {source}; this server runs PHP {here}. Cannot continue: the code the archive carries (vendor/, extensions and the composer.lock that resolved them) was built for PHP {source} and may use syntax the PHP {here} parser rejects — the restore would leave Flarum unable to boot. Upgrade this server to PHP {source} or later, or make the backup from an install running PHP {here}.
stack.missing_extensions: Cannot continue: this server is missing {count, plural, one {a required PHP extension} other {required PHP extensions}} that the backup's source had — {extensions}. Without {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} Flarum does not boot after the restore. Enable {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} in this server's PHP and try again.
stack.composer_update: This backup's composer.lock was resolved on PHP {source} and this server runs PHP {here}. Run `composer update` in the install root to re-resolve the dependencies for the local version.

errors.no_libsodium: libsodium is not available on this server.
errors.acknowledge_loss: Generating a new keypair will leave existing encrypted backups undecryptable on this server. Confirm to proceed.
errors.confirm_replace: You must confirm that this will replace existing data.
errors.empty_upload: Upload size must be greater than zero.
errors.upload_too_large: Upload exceeds the per-file ceiling ({size} bytes > {max}).
errors.upload_not_initialised: Upload session not initialised — start a new upload.
errors.upload_gone: Upload session not initialised or already cleaned up.
errors.upload_incomplete: Upload incomplete: {received} / {expected} bytes received. Re-send the missing chunks before inspecting.
errors.offset_out_of_range: Chunk offset is outside the declared upload size.
errors.seek_failed: Failed to seek to offset {offset} in the staging file.
errors.chunk_too_large: Chunk exceeds the per-request limit ({max} bytes).
errors.chunk_past_end: Chunk would write past the declared upload size.
errors.write_failed: Write failed at offset {offset} — disk full?
